visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with brown hair tied in a bun, wearing a white and black striped long-sleeved shirt and a beige apron, stands in a bright, modern kitchen. She stands behind a white induction cooktop that has a beige-colored deep frying pan and its matching lid. (2) Close-up shots show the bottom of the pan featuring the KOKI brand logo and a perforated induction base. Hands demonstrate the functionality of a detachable beige handle, clicking it onto and off of the pan's rim. (3) The woman performs a water droplet test on the hot pan, then adds oil and fries two eggs. She uses metal tongs to flip the eggs, demonstrating the non-stick surface. Following this, she fries strips of beef and then stir-fries a large portion of green spinach with garlic. (4) The woman holds up a plate of cooked beef while gesturing towards the stove. The scene includes an air fryer in the background. (5) In the final phase, the scene moves to a stainless steel sink where the woman removes the handle and washes the pan with a sponge and running water, showing how easily it cleans up.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 大家有沒有發現. (2) [Subtitle]: 最近很多做菜的KOL/網紅 都粉粉的在使用無塗層鍋. (3) [Subtitle]: 例如不鏽鋼或是鐵鍋. (4) [Subtitle]: 使用不鏽鋼鍋其實沒有想像中困難. (5) [Subtitle]: 只要掌握這個小技巧. (6) [Subtitle]: 首先先熱鍋. (7) [Subtitle]: 再做灑水測驗. (8) [Subtitle]: 水珠會快速在鍋子裡面跳動 像荷葉上的水珠. (9) [Subtitle]: 這樣子表示鍋子熱好了. (10) [Subtitle]: 這時候再倒油 鍋子已經很熱了. (11) [Subtitle]: 如果出現油煙 立刻把火關掉. (12) [Subtitle]: 等煙散掉 就可以下食材了. (13) [Subtitle]: 這時候煎蛋煎肉 都可以很不沾哦. (14) [Subtitle]: 還有一個小秘訣 我們的食材要先退冰. (15) [Subtitle]: 如果食材太冰 好不容易加熱的鍋子又瞬間降溫. (16) [Subtitle]: 這樣子就比較容易沾黏哦. (17) [Slogan]: 不需要太多油! 也不能不沾. (18) [Slogan]: 只要充分熱鍋 倒油 關火 等煙散掉 食材退冰 就可以很不沾囉!. (19) [Subtitle]: 多練習幾次 相信都能上手的. (20) [Slogan]: 不鏽鋼耐酸鹼/耐刮 可以長期使用. (21) [Subtitle]: 鍋內還很乾淨. (22) [Subtitle]: 不須再熱鍋 直接煮下一道. (23) [Subtitle]: 利用牛油來炒青菜 這個青菜會很香. (24) [Subtitle]: 這一點點焦不用擔心 我們青菜下來 水份很多 就可以把那個微焦帶走. (25) [Subtitle]: 我們食材下去之後 可以把火轉大一點. (26) [Subtitle]: 蔬菜的水份下來之後 鍋子就變乾淨了. (27) [Subtitle]: 可以連續煮3道菜的. (34) [Subtitle]: 這次想示範連煮三道菜 加上外面氣炸烤箱正在蒸螃蟹. (35) [Subtitle]: 這是簡單的煎肉排 平常你也可以做一些蔥爆啊 或者是炒青椒 炒磨菇之類的. (36) [Subtitle]: 中途你想洗鍋子也可以 但是你就要重新熱鍋 那我剛剛那個方式就是不用熱鍋. (37) [Subtitle]: 然後再外加我們的廚房小家電 這樣就可以幫助我們快速出菜. audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A cheerful female voice provides energetic narration with a fast speech rate and high intonation variability. An upbeat, major-key electronic pop track with a steady drum machine beat plays in the background at a balanced volume level. (2) A sharp metallic click occurs as a handle is attached. This is followed by the high-frequency sizzling sound of water evaporating on a hot surface and the crack of an eggshell. (3) The audio is dominated by the mid-range white noise of frying meat and sizzling oil. Occasional percussive clinks of metal tongs hitting the side of the pan punctuate the narration. The BGM maintains a consistent rhythmic drive. (4) Transition sound effects like digital pops or whooshes accompany visual scene changes. The sound of running water from a faucet creates a steady broadband noise floor, accompanied by the wet, squelching sound of a sponge scrubbing a metallic surface. (5) The speaker concludes with a warm, encouraging tone, while the music fades slightly towards the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Skill Demonstration -> Result Proof -> Durability/Cleaning Evidence -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a persuasive product demonstration and endorsement for a KOKI stainless steel pan. By combining a step-by-step tutorial on how to correctly heat an uncoated pan with evidence of its non-stick performance across multiple types of food (eggs, beef, and vegetables), the creator aims to prove the product's quality and ease of maintenance to potential customers.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The presenter explicitly showcases the pan's features, displays the brand logo prominently, and directs viewers to her YouTube channel for a more detailed review.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-density social media editing styles, such as variety-show text and rapid montages, to keep viewer engagement high while providing technical cooking advice.
